title: Homes around the world
examples: Why do people build houses in different shapes?
How does the weather change what people build?
Are all houses built using the same materials?

explain.say: Today we learn how climate shapes homes around the world.

items: Materials are chosen for the environment
Design keeps people safe and warm

explain.say: Igloos are homes made by people in very cold places.
Stilt houses are built up on tall posts near water.
Yurts are portable round homes used by nomadic people.
In very hot and dry places, people might use thick mud walls.
Think about a house built near a river that floods often.

faq.q: Why are igloos shaped like domes?
faq.a: The dome shape is very strong against falling snow and wind. It allows the structure to be stable in cold weather.
asks: What is the best shape for snow houses?

faq.q: What is the main purpose of building on stilts?
faq.a: Building on stilts helps keep the house dry from rising water or flooding. It also keeps animals from walking inside.
asks: Do stilts keep us safe from animals?

faq.q: Are yurts always used by people who move a lot?
faq.a: Yes, yurts are designed to be portable, making them perfect for nomadic groups. They can be set up and taken down easily.

faq.q: Does the climate affect the size of the house?
faq.a: Yes, a warmer climate might allow for larger windows, while a colder climate needs smaller openings to keep heat in.
asks: Are big houses for hot places?

faq.q: What materials are used in different parts of the world?
faq.a: Materials depend on what is available locally, like wood, mud, or snow. People use what they can find nearby.
asks: Can you use anything to build a house?

facts: Igloos are traditionally built from blocks of snow.
Stilt houses are common in areas with high water levels.
Yurts are portable dwellings used by nomadic cultures.
Climate dictates the best materials and design for shelter.

quiz.say: A group of people living in a very wet, tropical area might build their homes on:
quiz.why: Stilt houses keep the living area dry from rising water or flooding.

wrong.0: Yurts are best known for being portable homes for moving groups.
wrong.1: Mud houses are better for blocking heat in dry areas.
wrong.3: Igloos are designed for very cold, snowy environments.

quiz.say: If a community lives in a very cold, snowy region, which shelter would be most appropriate?
quiz.why: Igloos are specifically designed using snow blocks to withstand extreme cold.

wrong.0: Mud houses do not provide enough insulation against deep freezing temperatures.
wrong.2: Stilt houses are mainly for dealing with wet ground, not deep snow.
wrong.3: While yurts can be used, igloos are specialized for snow survival.

quiz.say: A family that moves from place to place often would most likely use:
quiz.why: Yurts are famous for being lightweight and easily assembled and disassembled.

wrong.1: Igloos require a lot of snow and are hard to move quickly.
wrong.2: Building stilts requires a fixed, stable location.
wrong.3: Stone houses are very heavy and cannot be moved by hand.
